name: adaptive-dark
description: A port of Safari's Adaptive Dark Mode: darkens light web pages that don't support dark mode, preserving hue and contrast.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:syntax && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --filename adaptive-dark-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node scripts/zip-dir.js dist/chrome web-ext-artifacts/adaptive-dark-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip
